title: senecio curvisquamus
intro: Senecio curvisquamus, commonly known as the Curly-leaf Ragwort, is a flowering plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been found to possess potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, skin issues, and respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in Senecio curvisquamus include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
